nodes.name: Read retention_days
nodes.notes: Single-account system (same limit(1) pattern as lib/supabase/account.ts). Zero rows means no settings row exists yet (Settings page never opened) -- 'Retention set?' then receives zero items and neither of its branches executes, which is the correct outcome (never configured = do nothing).

nodes.name: Retention set?
nodes.notes: architect/04-data-model.md: 'Not set' is a real, permanent option for retention_days, not an unconfigured default -- a null value means keep forever and this branch must exit, not fall back to some built-in number of days.

nodes.name: Login
nodes.notes: Reuses DASHBOARD_LOGIN_SECRET -- already required by the dashboard itself, no new secret. Requires a new DASHBOARD_BASE_URL n8n environment variable (the deployed dashboard's reachable base URL), same convention rule-engine.json's 'Call draft webhook' already established for SELF_BASE_URL. Full Response is on so 'Extract session cookie' can read the Set-Cookie header -- middleware.ts is deny-by-default, so /api/settings/cleanup needs a real session, and this is the same login path a human operator uses, not a separate machine-auth mechanism.

nodes.name: Call cleanup
nodes.notes: Delegates to gmail-dashboard/app/api/settings/cleanup/route.ts rather than reimplementing the candidate rule in SQL, so the promotional/social-only scope and the starred/sent/has-work guards live in exactly one place (PHASE-6-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md Wave 3). This means retention only ever removes low-value mail, never a blanket 'delete everything older than N days' -- the Settings page copy next to this control says so.

parameters.content:
## Retention Sweep

Daily, 3am. Makes settings.retention_days real -- previously written by PATCH /api/settings and rendered on the Settings page, read by nothing (PHASE-6-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md Wave 5).

Null retention_days ('Not set') exits without deleting anything -- that is a real, permanent choice, not a missing default. Otherwise logs into the dashboard with the operator's own DASHBOARD_LOGIN_SECRET and calls POST /api/settings/cleanup with olderThanDays=retention_days, so this workflow never duplicates that route's deletion rule or its starred/sent/has-work guards.

See PHASE-6-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md Wave 5.

### Placeholders to fill in on import

- **Supabase Postgres** credential must be created and attached to 'Read retention_days'.
- **DASHBOARD_BASE_URL** n8n environment variable -- the deployed dashboard's reachable base URL (same convention as rule-engine.json's SELF_BASE_URL).
- **DASHBOARD_LOGIN_SECRET** must already be set as an n8n environment variable, matching the dashboard's own gmail-dashboard/.env.local value.
